简短人物资料、日常安排和基本说明: Short profiles, routines, and basic descriptions
简单交际目的和一步式指示: Simple communicative purposes and one-step instructions
回复非常短的实用消息: Reply to a very short practical message
表达直接需要和熟悉内容: Express direct needs and familiar content
简单日常互动与安排确认: Simple everyday interaction and arrangement confirmation
理解基本个人和熟悉信息: Understand basic personal and familiar information
从极短、清楚的口头表达中识别姓名、住处、工作或学习、家庭关系、喜好或日常活动。: Identify names, residence, work or study, family relationships, preferences, or daily activities in very short, clearly delivered spoken texts.
输入简短、语速清楚；不要求隐含意义或复杂指代。: Input is short and clearly delivered; no implied meaning or complex reference is required.
从短对话、留言、通知或广播中找到时间、日期、地点、数量、价格、电话、房间号、线路: Locate times, dates, places, quantities, prices, phone numbers, room numbers, route numbers, or simple arrangements in short dialogues, messages, announcements, or broadcasts.
一至三个显性信息点；不要求复杂推断。: One to three explicit information points; no complex inference is required.
理解简单交际目的和指示: Understand simple communicative purposes and instructions
理解问候、感谢、道歉、问题、请求、邀请、确认问题和一步式指示。: Understand greetings, thanks, apologies, questions, requests, invitations, confirmation questions, and one-step instructions.
只判断直接目的或行动；选择适当回应不构成 Interaction。: Assess only the direct purpose or action; selecting an appropriate response does not constitute Interaction.
理解标志、标签和简短通知: Understand signs, labels, and short notices
理解入口、出口、楼层、房间号、营业或上课时间、简单许可和禁止、商品与价格。: Understand entrances, exits, floors, room numbers, business or class times, simple permissions and prohibitions, products, and prices.
文字很短、结构清楚；不依赖文化知识。: Text is very short and clearly structured; success does not depend on cultural knowledge.
从短消息和实用文本中找到关键信息: Find key information in short messages and practical texts
从消息、菜单、日程、课程表、活动信息、表格、预约和工作安排中定位显性事实。: Locate explicit facts in messages, menus, schedules, timetables, event information, forms, appointments, and work arrangements.
材料短、可重读；不要求态度、论证或长篇理解。: Materials are short and can be reread; no interpretation of attitude, argument, or extended text is required.
用词语、固定表达和简单句介绍本人或熟悉人物并说明住处、工作、学习、联系方式或日程: Use words, formulaic expressions, and simple sentences to introduce oneself or a familiar person and state residence, work, study, contact details, or schedule.
允许停顿和错误；不要求长篇自我介绍。: Pauses and errors are acceptable; an extended self-introduction is not required.
表达喜好、想要、需要、能力、当前活动、天气、饮食偏好、身体不适或简单描述。: Express likes, wants, needs, abilities, current activities, weather, food preferences, basic health problems, or simple descriptions.
一至三个简单句；不要求解释原因或比较。: One to three simple sentences; no explanation of reasons or comparison is required.
使用简体中文、数字和日期格式填写姓名、国籍、城市、生日、电话、工作或学习和可参加: Use Simplified Chinese, numbers, and date formats to enter a name, nationality, city, birthday, phone number, work or study information, and availability.
四至六个清楚字段；不要求真实敏感信息。: Four to six clearly labelled fields; no real sensitive information is required.
编写非常短的实用消息: Write a very short practical message
写一条包含一至三个内容点的短消息，用于邀请、确认安排、表达需要、提问或回复课程、: Write a short message containing one to three content points to invite, confirm an arrangement, express a need, ask a question, or reply about a course, appointment, or work matter.
非常短、目的明确；不要求正式长邮件。: The message is very short and has a clear purpose; a formal or extended email is not required.
回答有关本人和熟悉生活的问题，并主动提出一个简单相关问题。: Answer questions about oneself and familiar daily life, and initiate one simple relevant question.
两至三轮；允许有限重复和帮助。: Two to three turns; limited repetition and assistance are allowed.
完成简单、可预测的日常交换: Complete a simple, predictable everyday exchange
在点餐、询价、购票、问路、确认课程或预约、请求物品和求助中完成简短交流。: Complete a short exchange when ordering food, asking a price, buying a ticket, asking for directions, confirming a course or appointment, requesting an object, or asking for help.
高度熟悉场景，两至三轮，不进行复杂协商。: A highly familiar situation with two to three turns and no complex negotiation.
口头约定或确认简单安排: Arrange or confirm a simple plan orally
口头询问、说明或确认见面、上课、工作、活动、预约和是否参加。: Ask about, state, or confirm a meeting, class, work arrangement, activity, appointment, or attendance orally.
只处理时间、地点和参加状态等显性安排。: Address only explicit arrangements such as time, place, and attendance status.
书面约定或确认简单安排: Arrange or confirm a simple plan in writing
通过非常短的消息询问、说明或确认课程、工作、活动、预约和是否参加。: Use a very short message to ask about, state, or confirm a course, work arrangement, activity, appointment, or attendance.
必须实际回应消息；不能以选择预设回复代替。: The candidate must produce an actual reply; selecting a predefined response is not sufficient.
维持和修复最基本的交流: Maintain and repair a basic exchange
表示没听懂，请求重复、放慢、帮助，或确认词语、数字、时间和地点。: Signal a lack of understanding; ask for repetition, slower speech, or help; or confirm a word, number, time, or place.
使用少量固定表达；输入本身不得故意含糊或过快。: Use a small set of formulaic expressions; the input itself must not be deliberately ambiguous or excessively fast.
从短通知、时间表、信息卡或消息中选择一至三个相关信息点并口头告诉指定对象。: Select one to three relevant information points from a short notice, timetable, information card, or message and relay them orally to a specified recipient.
单一短来源和显性信息；不总结、解释或比较。: Use one short source with explicit information; no summarising, explaining, or comparing is required.
书面转告简单明确信息: Relay simple explicit information in writing
从短源材料选择时间、地点、价格、数量或安排并写成一条给指定对象的短消息。: Select a time, place, price, quantity, or arrangement from a short source and write a short message to a specified recipient.
必须形成面向接收者的消息；机械复制不能单独证明中介。: The response must be a recipient-oriented message; mechanical copying alone does not demonstrate mediation.
问候、告别、简单介绍和基本社交表达。: Greetings, leave-taking, simple introductions, and basic social expressions.
姓名、国籍、住处、年龄、生日、电话、工作或学习。: Name, nationality, residence, age, birthday, phone number, work, or study.
家人、朋友、同学、老师和同事的基本关系与信息。: Basic relationships and information about family, friends, classmates, teachers, and colleagues.
描述熟悉的人、物品和地点: Describe familiar people, objects, and places
颜色、大小、数量、位置和明显特征。: Colour, size, quantity, location, and visible features.
喜欢、不喜欢、想要、需要、会、不会和少量兴趣。: Likes, dislikes, wants, needs, abilities, and a small set of interests.
谈论日常活动和当前情况: Talk about routines and current situations
日常活动、当前动作、当前天气和近期简单安排。: Routines, current actions, current weather, and simple near-term arrangements.
表达基本健康和帮助需要: Express basic health and help needs
基本身体不适、医生和帮助请求。: Basic symptoms, doctors, and requests for help.
看菜单、点一两种食物或饮料、数量和基本偏好。: Reading a menu, ordering one or two items, quantities, and basic preferences.
价格、颜色、大小、数量和简单付款。: Price, colour, size, quantity, and simple payment.
线路、车次、时间、购票和上下车地点。: Routes, service numbers, times, tickets, and boarding or alighting points.
询问和说明基本位置: Ask for and state a basic location
询问地点、说明基本位置和一步式方向。: Asking for a place, stating a basic location, and giving one-step directions.
理解公共标志和开放信息: Understand public signs and opening information
入口、出口、楼层、房间号、开放时间和简单许可禁止。: Entrances, exits, floors, room numbers, opening hours, and simple permissions or prohibitions.
约定或确认时间和地点: Arrange or confirm a time and place
见面、邀请、课程、活动和简单预约。: Meetings, invitations, courses, activities, and simple appointments.
姓名、入住日期、房间号、早餐、退房和设施位置。: Name, arrival date, room number, breakfast, checkout, and facility locations.
理解和确认基本课程信息: Understand and confirm basic course information
课程名称、时间、教室、教师和一步式课堂指示。: Course name, time, room, teacher, and one-step classroom instructions.
完成简单报名和课堂交流: Complete simple registration and classroom exchanges
填写课程资料、回复课程消息、询问词语或教室并请求重复。: Entering course details, replying to course messages, asking about words or rooms, and requesting repetition.
提供和理解基本工作信息: Provide and understand basic work information
职业、工作地点、上下班、简单排班和同事是否在。: Occupation, workplace, shifts, simple schedules, and whether a colleague is present.
一步式工作请求、请求物品、到达时间、会议安排和求助。: One-step work requests, requesting objects, arrival times, meeting arrangements, and asking for help.
阅读和回复非常短的在线消息: Read and reply to a very short online message
确认时间、告知地点、接受拒绝邀请、说明参加和简单提问。: Confirming a time, stating a place, accepting or declining an invitation, indicating attendance, and asking simple questions.
填写表格并转告关键信息: Complete a form and relay key information
填写基本资料并从短材料找到和转告显性实用信息。: Entering basic details and finding and relaying explicit practical information from a short source.
限具体身份、职业、关系或类别；不处理抽象定义和“是……的”。: Limited to specific identities, occupations, relationships, or categories; excludes abstract definitions and the 是……的 construction.
X 为简短姓名或题目提供的名字。: X is a short name or a name supplied by the item.
限一个常见或题目提供的姓氏。: Limited to one common surname or a surname supplied by the item.
限具体人、物、时间和家庭关系。: Limited to specific people, objects, times, and family relationships.
限明确的没有；不处理复杂时体。: Limited to explicit absence or non-possession; excludes complex tense and aspect.
说明某处有人或物: State that a person or object is at a location
限一个地点和少量具体人或物。: Limited to one location and a small number of specific people or objects.
限一个清楚的具体地点。: Limited to one clearly specified location.
限一步式、单一参照物的方位。: Limited to a one-step spatial relationship with a single reference object.
通常只含一个主要动作和简单宾语。: Normally limited to one main action and a simple object.
表达时间地点动作顺序: Order time, subject, location, and action
不处理多重时间状语和复杂语序。: Excludes multiple time adverbials and complex word order.
描述基本性质或状态: Describe a basic quality or state
限高频、具体、可观察或感受的形容词。: Limited to frequent, concrete adjectives describing observable or felt qualities.
表达明显程度或变化: Express an obvious degree or change
限直接、明显的程度。: Limited to direct and obvious degrees.
限轻微程度或身体感受。: Limited to a slight degree or a physical sensation.
A 通常为人称、姓名或短名词；不处理长定语。: A is normally a pronoun, name, or short noun; excludes long modifiers.
表示人物复数: Mark a plural group of people
只用于人称代词和常见人物称谓。: Used only with personal pronouns and common terms for people.
只用批准的常见量词。: Uses only approved common measure words.
限直接数量、价格或人数。: Limited to a direct quantity, price, or number of people.
限课程、楼层、房间和小序数。: Limited to lessons, floors, rooms, and small ordinal numbers.
问题只含一个主要信息点。: The question contains only one main information point.
只处理简单能力、参加和许可。: Limited to simple ability, participation, and permission.
询问人物或事物: Ask about a person or thing
只询问一个具体人物、物品、活动或信息。: Asks about only one specific person, object, activity, or piece of information.
限少量、清楚候选项。: Limited to a small number of clearly defined options.
只询问一个地点或位置。: Asks about only one place or position.
询问日期时间价格: Ask about a date, time, or price
限直接数字、日期、时间、价格或数量。: Limited to direct numbers, dates, times, prices, or quantities.
询问方法或情况: Ask about a method or condition
只处理一步式方法、状态或简单评价。: Limited to a one-step method, state, or simple evaluation.

否定习惯、意愿或一般事实: Negate a habit, intention, or general fact
只处理一般否定、意愿否定或当前判断。: Limited to general negation, negated intention, or a current judgement.
否定已发生或表示没有: Negate a completed action or express absence
只处理简单未发生、未完成或没有。: Limited to a simple action that did not happen or was not completed, or to absence.
表达简单禁止或劝阻: Express a simple prohibition or warning
限一步式、直接、情境清楚的禁止。: Limited to a direct, one-step prohibition in a clear context.
表达意愿、需要或计划: Express an intention, need, or plan
只处理直接需要和近期简单安排。: Limited to direct needs and simple near-term arrangements.
只处理基本技能、现实可能性或简单许可。: Limited to a basic skill, realistic possibility, or simple permission.
只处理当前可观察或明确说明的动作。: Limited to a current action that is observable or explicitly stated.
只处理一个已经完成的具体动作；不叙述连续过去经历。: Limited to one specific completed action; excludes sequences of past events.
表达新情况或状态变化: Express a new situation or change of state
只表示显而易见或直接说明的新情况。: Expresses only a new situation that is obvious or directly stated.
只连接两个简单名词或代词。: Connects only two simple nouns or pronouns.
表达相同或补充情况: Express a parallel or additional fact
只补充一个相同或并行事实。: Adds only one similar or parallel fact.
表达全体或共同情况: Express a shared situation involving all members
集合范围必须清楚且很小。: The group must be clearly defined and small.
限继续、另外或仍然的直接意义。: Limited to the direct meanings of continuation, addition, or persistence.
表达再次动作: Express a repeated or later action
只表示一次简单重复或稍后再做。: Expresses only one simple repetition or an action to be done later.
一次只提出一个直接请求。: Makes only one direct request at a time.
只处理简单许可或安排可行性。: Limited to simple permission or the feasibility of an arrangement.
只用于少量高频请求；不要求语用细微辨析。: Used only with a small set of frequent requests; no fine-grained pragmatic distinction is required.
提出简单建议或确认: Make a simple suggestion or confirmation
只用于明显、低风险的建议或确认。: Used only for obvious, low-risk suggestions or confirmations.
给出物品或服务: Give an item or provide a service
只处理具体物品或简单服务。: Limited to a specific object or simple service.
信息限一至三个显性事实；不处理复杂引语。: Information is limited to one to three explicit facts; excludes complex reported speech.
表达交通方式和目的地: Express a mode of transport and destination
不处理复杂换乘和多段行程。: Excludes complex transfers and multi-leg journeys.
表达起止范围: Express a range from a starting point to an endpoint
只连接一组明确起点和终点。: Connects only one clearly defined starting point and endpoint.
表达上下交通工具: Express boarding or alighting from transport
只处理一个上下车点。: Limited to one boarding or alighting point.
最多一个转向或一个直接行走指令。: Limited to one turn or one direct walking instruction.
只处理常见、清楚的日期格式。: Limited to common, clearly presented date formats.
只处理常见整点、半点和简单分钟。: Limited to common whole hours, half hours, and simple minute values.
不要求连续叙述过去事件。: Does not require a sequence of past events.
只在两个明确选项之间确认。: Confirms a choice between only two explicit options.
限一个清楚的限制范围。: Limited to one clearly defined scope of restriction.
只用于两个直接步骤；不得发展为多步骤说明。: Used for only two direct steps; must not expand into multi-step instructions.
只处理整体近远，不要求距离计算。: Limited to general proximity or distance; no distance calculation is required.
普通服务场景可用“你好”；需要直接礼貌称呼时可用“您好”。: Use “你好” in ordinary service interactions; use “您好” when a direct polite form of address is needed.
直接、友好结束。: End directly and in a friendly manner.
对帮助、服务或信息表示感谢: Express thanks for help, service, or information
可单独或句末使用。: May be used independently or at the end of a sentence.
表示不用谢: Indicate that no thanks are necessary
不要求细分正式程度。: No fine distinction in formality is required.
对迟到、不能参加或小问题道歉: Apologise for being late, being unable to attend, or a minor problem
只处理低风险、直接道歉。: Limit use to direct apologies in low-stakes situations.
表示不介意: Indicate that the issue is not a problem
不处理严重事件。: Do not use for serious incidents.
吸引注意并提出问题: Attract attention and ask a question
不能把是否使用“请问”作为唯一正确形式。: The use of “请问” must not be the sole criterion for correctness.
请求物品、行动或许可: Request an item, action, or permission
请求必须具体、一步式。: The request must be specific and involve one step.
明确表示需要帮助: State clearly that help is needed
确认词语、数字、时间、地点或安排: Confirm a word, number, time, place, or arrangement
确认对象必须明确。: The information being confirmed must be explicit.
请对方重复刚才的话: Ask the other person to repeat what was just said
只能播放预先批准的重复版本。: Only a pre-approved repetition may be played.
请对方说慢一点: Ask the other person to speak more slowly
不能用故意过快输入诱发。: Do not elicit this function through deliberately over-fast input.
明确表示理解困难: State clearly that understanding is difficult
允许固定表达；不要求解释哪里不懂。: Fixed expressions are allowed; explaining the exact source of difficulty is not required.
表示能够或愿意参加: Indicate ability or willingness to attend
应结合时间或地点确认。: Confirm the time or place as part of the response.
简短表示不能参加: State briefly that attendance is not possible
在个人问答或日常交换中主动提一个简单问题: Initiate one simple question in a personal interview or everyday exchange
问题必须与当前情境直接相关。: The question must relate directly to the current context.
说明所需物品和数量: State the required item and quantity
不处理定制、投诉或复杂偏好。: Do not cover customisation, complaints, or complex preferences.
面向指定对象转告: Relaying information to a specified recipient
选择并转告与接收者有关的信息: Select and relay information relevant to the recipient
必须有源材料、接收者和目的；不等同机械复制。: Source material, a recipient, and a purpose are required; mechanical copying is not sufficient.
核心词项按本级义项和读音朗读；多音字必须结合词语人工确认。: Read core lexical items using their level-specific meanings and pronunciations; manually confirm polyphonic characters in context.
拼音读音支持使用声调符号；轻声按自然普通话实现。: Use tone marks for pinyin pronunciation support; realise neutral tones in natural Standard Mandarin.
一、不及连续三声等常见变调按自然语流实现，但 Registry 保存词典形式和实: Realise common tone sandhi, including 一, 不, and consecutive third tones, in natural connected speech; retain dictionary forms and actual audio QA results in the Registry.
儿化只在固定词形中自然出现，不把地区性儿化作为理解前提。: Use erhua naturally only in fixed word forms; do not make regional erhua a prerequisite for comprehension.
年份、电话号码、房间号和线路号按真实标识方式朗读；价格、日期和钟点保持同类任务一: Read years, phone numbers, room numbers, and route numbers as they would appear on authentic signs; keep prices, dates, and times consistent across comparable tasks.
人名、地名、外来词、数字密集片段和 TTS 易错词必须人工试听。: Human reviewers must listen to person names, place names, loanwords, number-dense segments, and words that TTS commonly mispronounces.
音频必须逐字对应批准的 authoringTranscript，不通过重音、停顿: Audio must match the approved authoringTranscript word for word and must not signal the answer through stress, pauses, or intonation.
同一角色、平行任务和同一任务中的声音、音量和基本语速条件保持可比。: Keep voice, volume, and baseline speaking-rate conditions comparable for the same role, parallel tasks, and turns within one task.
超出核心范围的人名可在首次出现时统一提供拼音，或保持在源材料中可见；不得成为唯一: Person names outside the core scope may receive consistent pinyin support on first occurrence or remain visible in the source material; they must not be the sole target words.
地点名只用于建立情境；位置任务仍须由核心方位语言完成。: Place names may only establish context; location tasks must still be completed using core location language.
机构名不要求事先掌握，且不得依赖制度知识。: Institution names must not require prior knowledge or depend on institutional knowledge.
课程名可以照录或转告，但不能作为唯一证明阅读或写作能力的计分点。: Course names may be copied or relayed, but they must not be the sole scored evidence of reading or writing ability.
活动名称应具体、成人化、无文化背景要求。: Activity names must be specific, adult-appropriate, and independent of cultural background knowledge.
只在真实情境确有必要时使用；题目必须仍包含核心语言计分证据。: Use only when genuinely necessary for an authentic context; the item must still contain scored evidence of core language.
特定地域食物可作为菜单内容，但不得要求全球 A1 考生事先知道。: Region-specific foods may appear on a menu, but global A1 candidates must not be expected to know them in advance.
只使用完成定位或照录所需的简短地址片段，不要求复杂地址知识。: Use only the short address segment needed for locating or copying; do not require complex address knowledge.
线路、车次、柜台和服务标签必须清楚，数字格式不得制造陷阱。: Route, service number, counter, and service labels must be clear; number formatting must not create traps.
批准的拉丁字母专名可保留原样；大小写不作为核心语言难点。: Approved Latin-script proper names may remain unchanged; letter case must not be treated as a core language difficulty.
操作标签属于界面语言，不得计入目标语言能力。: Control labels are interface language and must not count toward target-language ability.
原则上避免；确有必要时必须解释且不能成为答案依据。: Avoid by default; when genuinely necessary, provide an explanation and do not make it the basis of the answer.
同一字符区间不得同时重复计入一个长词和其内部短词，除非人工明确要求交叉标记。: Do not count the same character span as both a longer word and an internal shorter word unless a reviewer explicitly requires overlapping annotation.
分别记录 stimulus、prompt、options 和 expected: Record token positions separately for the stimulus, prompt, options, and expected response concepts.
标点、数字、拉丁字母和支持性专名单独分段，不自动视为核心词汇。: Segment punctuation, numbers, Latin letters, and supported proper names separately; do not automatically treat them as core vocabulary.
未匹配片段生成 reviewFinding，而不是自动加入核心范围。: Create a reviewFinding for unmatched spans instead of adding them automatically to the core scope.
自动匹配只做初筛；多义词、词边界、姓名和语法功能词必须人工确认。: Automated matching is only a first pass; polysemy, word boundaries, names, and grammatical function words require human confirmation.
visibleCharacterIds 记录题面全部汉字；requiredCha: visibleCharacterIds records every Chinese character shown in the item; requiredCharacterIds records only characters that must be recognised to complete the task without support.
简繁转换不得用于自动把考生答案判对，原始文本必须保留。: Do not use simplified/traditional conversion to mark candidate responses correct automatically; retain the original text.
理解短标志、标签或通知的直接含义: Understand the direct meaning of short signs, labels, or notices
从短消息或消息线程找到显性事实: Find explicit facts in a short message or message thread
从菜单、表格和时间表定位信息: Locate information in menus, tables, and timetables
理解人物资料、日常安排或一步式说明: Understand profiles, routines, or one-step instructions
将短口头信息与人物、图片或活动对应: Match short spoken information to people, images, or activities
从短对话识别一个明确细节: Identify one explicit detail in a short dialogue
从通知或留言提取并记录信息: Extract and record information from an announcement or message
理解问题、请求、邀请、确认或一步式指示: Understand a question, request, invitation, confirmation, or one-step instruction
在表格中输入基本资料: Enter basic details in a form
针对指定对象和目的作出书面回应: Write a response for a specified recipient and purpose
从源材料选择信息并写给指定对象: Select information from source material and write it to a specified recipient
回答个人问题并提出简单相关问题: Answer personal questions and ask a simple relevant question
根据提示表达直接需要或熟悉内容: Express a direct need or familiar content in response to a prompt
完成两至三轮可预测互动: Complete a predictable interaction of two to three turns
从源材料选择信息并口头转告: Select information from source material and relay it orally
清楚、自然、较慢，适用于关键信息密集的 A1 输入。: Clear, natural, and slower, for A1 input containing dense key information.
清楚、自然、不急促，适用于极短熟悉表达。: Clear, natural, and unhurried, for very short familiar expressions.
按自然短句和信息组停顿，不在答案前后异常停顿。: Pause by natural short sentences and information groups, with no unusual pause before or after the answer.
说话人轮次清楚，轮次间有一致自然停顿。: Keep speaker turns clear, with consistent natural pauses between turns.
通知“星期一不开门”，考生选择星期一不能做什么；答案由文字直接确定。: A notice states “星期一不开门”; the candidate selects what cannot be done on Monday, and the text determines the answer directly.
只凭文化特定图标即可作答，且文字含未支持的表外关键词。: The answer can be inferred from a culture-specific icon alone, while the text contains unsupported out-of-scope keywords.
一个高频标志和明显情境。: One high-frequency sign in an obvious context.
一个短句含一个明确事实或否定。: One short sentence containing one explicit fact or negation.
短通知含两个相关显性信息，干扰项较接近。: A short notice containing two related explicit facts, with relatively close distractors.
两轮消息说明“明天下午三点在图书馆门口见”，考生定位时间和地点。: A two-turn exchange states “明天下午三点在图书馆门口见”; the candidate identifies the time and place.
要求推断发送者是否生气。: Requires inferring whether the sender is angry.
单条消息和一个信息点。: One message and one information point.
2-3 轮消息和两个信息点。: A 2–3-turn exchange with two information points.
3-4 轮短消息，含少量无关信息。: A 3–4-turn short exchange containing a small amount of irrelevant information.
课程表列出课程、时间、教室，考生定位星期二九点的教室。: A timetable lists courses, times, and classrooms; the candidate locates the classroom for Tuesday at 9:00.
密集表格并要求计算课间时长。: A dense table that requires calculating the duration of breaks.
一列或简短列表。: One column or a short list.
清楚小表格查一个字段。: Locate one field in a clear, small table.
连接同一行两个显性字段。: Connect two explicit fields in the same row.
三句人物资料说明姓名、工作地点和下班时间，考生选择明确信息。: A three-sentence profile states a name, workplace, and finishing time; the candidate selects explicitly stated information.
长篇过去经历并判断态度。: A long account of past experience that asks the candidate to judge attitude.
2 句、1 人、1 目标事实。: Two sentences, one person, and one target fact.
3 句、2 个信息点。: Three sentences and two information points.
4 句和少量相近事实。: Four sentences with a small number of similar facts.
听“安娜在学校学汉语”，选择对应人物活动图片。: The candidate hears “安娜在学校学汉语” and selects the matching picture of the person and activity.
只用最小声调对制造陷阱。: Uses only a minimal tone contrast to create a trap.
单句一个信息点和明显图片。: One sentence, one information point, and an obvious image.
短句加一个非目标信息。: A short sentence with one non-target detail.
极短交流含两个熟悉信息。: A very short exchange containing two familiar details.
听两轮对话确认“一杯茶二十元”，选择价格。: The candidate hears a two-turn dialogue confirming “一杯茶二十元” and selects the price.
多次自我修正并以三道依赖题考记忆。: Contains repeated self-correction and tests memory through three dependent questions.
2 轮、目标在句尾。: Two turns, with the target at the end of the sentence.
2-3 轮、一个无关细节。: Two to three turns with one irrelevant detail.
3 轮、相近数字或地点但答案显性。: Three turns containing similar numbers or places, but with an explicit answer.
听课程留言，填写“星期三、九点、305教室”三个独立字段。: The candidate hears a course message and completes three independent fields: “星期三”, “九点”, and “305教室”.
听写完整句子和大量汉字。: Requires dictating full sentences and a large number of Chinese characters.
一段音频一个数字字段。: One audio passage and one numeric field.
2 个按顺序出现的信息点。: Two information points presented in order.
3 个信息点和少量非目标信息。: Three information points and a small amount of non-target information.
听“请在门口等一下”，选择应采取的行动。: The candidate hears “请在门口等一下” and selects the action to take.
把选择适当回应标成 Interaction。: Labels selection of an appropriate response as Interaction.
直接请求、选项差异大。: A direct request with clearly distinct options.
常见确认或一步指示。: A familiar confirmation or one-step instruction.
语用相近选项，但只有一个在情境中合适。: Pragmatically similar options, with only one appropriate in context.
根据资料卡或自选虚构信息填写姓名、城市、生日、电话和学习情况。: Complete name, city, date of birth, phone, and study details from a profile card or self-selected fictional information.
要求真实证件号、完整住址，且全部机械复制。: Requires a real identity-document number and full address, with every field copied mechanically.
4 字段、2 个中文字段。: Four fields, including two Chinese-language fields.
5 字段、混合中文和数字。: Five fields combining Chinese text and numbers.
6 字段并从资料卡选择少量信息。: Six fields requiring limited selection from a profile card.
朋友邀请明天下午见面；回复能否参加并确认地点。: A friend invites the candidate to meet tomorrow afternoon; the candidate replies whether they can attend and confirms the place.
写与源消息无关的陈述或正式长邮件。: Writes a statement unrelated to the source message or a long formal email.
1 个必要内容点和强提示。: One required content point with strong prompting.
2 个内容点，回应并确认安排。: Two content points that respond to and confirm the arrangement.
3 个内容点并提出一个简单问题。: Three content points plus one simple question.
从课程通知选择时间和教室，给同学写短消息。: Select the time and classroom from a course notice and write a short message to a classmate.
逐字复制整份通知，没有指定接收者。: Copies the entire notice word for word without a specified recipient.
一个相关信息点和明显接收者。: One relevant information point and an obvious recipient.
两个相关信息点和少量无关信息。: Two relevant information points and a small amount of irrelevant information.
三个信息点，需加入简单行动要求。: Three information points plus a simple requested action.
回答住在哪里、学习什么，并主动问对方一个相关问题。: Answer where the candidate lives and what they study, then initiate one related question.
连续两分钟背诵自我介绍。: Recites a memorised self-introduction continuously for two minutes.
两个直接问题和明确提问框架。: Two direct questions with an explicit question frame.
2-3 轮并主动提一个相关问题。: Two to three turns, including one candidate-initiated related question.
有限追问，提示更少但仍可预测。: Limited follow-up questions with less prompting, while remaining predictable.
根据信息卡说出身体不适和需要的帮助，回答 1-3 句。: Use an information card to state a health problem and the help needed in one to three sentences.
讲述病史、原因和治疗计划。: Describes medical history, causes, and a treatment plan.
一个内容点和图片支持。: One content point with image support.
三个内容点并连接两个简单信息。: Three content points connecting two simple details.
在餐厅完成 2-3 轮点餐和数量确认，并实际提出一次请求。: Complete a 2–3-turn restaurant exchange to order and confirm quantity, including one spoken request.
只点击答案或由生成式 AI 临时改变问题。: Only clicks an answer, or lets generative AI change the question dynamically.
固定两轮和明显提示。: Two fixed turns with obvious prompting.
三轮含一次请求或确认。: Three turns containing one request or confirmation.
有限分支或交流修复，分支已预先审核。: Limited branching or communication repair, with every branch reviewed in advance.
查看公交信息卡，把线路、时间和上车地点口头告诉朋友。: Read a bus information card and tell a friend the route, time, and boarding point orally.
朗读整张信息卡或总结多条线路。: Reads the entire information card aloud or summarises multiple routes.
两个信息点和明确对象。: Two information points and an explicit recipient.
三个信息点和少量无关信息。: Three information points and a small amount of irrelevant information.
相关但没有清楚确认安排。: Relevant, but does not confirm the arrangement clearly.
主要行为完成，但地点只以问题提出。: Completes the main communicative action, but only asks about the place.
回应邀请并确认时间和地点。: Responds to the invitation and confirms the time and place.
只转告一个不完整信息点。: Relays only one incomplete information point.
主要信息准确，形式略简略。: The main information is accurate, though the form is slightly abbreviated.
准确选择并面向接收者转告全部信息。: Selects all information accurately and relays it to the recipient.
少量相关信息，没有主动提问。: Provides limited relevant information without initiating a question.
主要行为完成，有小问题但可理解。: Completes the main communicative action with minor but intelligible issues.
回答问题并主动提问。: Answers the questions and initiates a question.
信息完整且可理解。: The information is complete and intelligible.
完成饮料和数量。: Provides both the drink and quantity.
没有可理解互动证据。: Provides no intelligible evidence of interaction.
完成回应和确认，语言有限。: Completes the response and confirmation with limited language.
完成多轮回应和请求。: Completes the multi-turn responses and request.
只有一个不完整信息点。: Provides only one incomplete information point.
准确转告三个信息点。: Relays all three information points accurately.
系统故障不得直接记为考生零分；先恢复、受控重试、排除无效题或判定证据不足。: A system failure must not automatically give the candidate a zero; first recover, allow a controlled retry, exclude the invalid item, or record insufficient evidence as appropriate.
一份材料、一个问题和至少两个选项。: One stimulus, one question, and at least two options.
至少两项左侧材料与右侧答案进行匹配。: Match at least two prompts with the available answers.
读取或听取短材料，并填写直接信息。: Read or listen to a short stimulus and enter explicit information.
填写 4–6 个简短表单字段。: Complete four to six short form fields.
按收件人、目的和内容点写一条简短消息。: Write a short message for the specified recipient, purpose, and content points.
按可见提示或音频提示完成一段简短口语表达。: Give one short spoken response to a visible or audio prompt.
考官与考生按固定路径完成至少一问一答。: Complete a fixed-path exchange with at least one prompt and response.
无效作答按合同统一处理: Invalid responses are handled consistently under the contract
允许：approved equivalence among YYYY-MM-DD: Allowed: approved equivalence among YYYY-MM-DD, 年月日 and 月日 forms when task permits
禁止：swap month and day without approved l: Prohibited: swap month and day without approved locale rule
禁止：infer missing year when required: Prohibited: infer missing year when required
允许：approved equivalence among 9:00, 09:0: Allowed: approved equivalence among 9:00, 09:00 and 上午九点 when semantically identical
允许：ignore explicitly non-target final pu: Allowed: ignore explicitly non-target final punctuation
允许：apply each field-specific approved no: Allowed: apply each field-specific approved normalization rule
禁止：one global fuzzy rule for all fields: Prohibited: one global fuzzy rule for all fields
